reviewMethod: Visually inspected the final native contact sheet containing all three complete dialog crops on this API.
findings: Provider waiting shows zero copied bytes, an explicit storage-provider wait, and no invented rate or time estimate.
Recent copying shows a measured byte rate and an estimate explicitly limited to the current phase.
Pause retains copied-byte progress and offers Resume while hiding the rate and time estimate.
Titles, file and phase labels, Details, Open folder and history controls are readable; dialog borders and footer are complete.
Public crops exclude the private browser/sidebar and contain only synthetic transfer names.
